{
  "dataset_name": "adult_income",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "age_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Age centered and scaled to roughly unit range for smooth linear projection.",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth continuous age signal suitable for linear margin computation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(age - 38.587) / 13.24"
    },
    {
      "name": "education_num_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Years of education standardized.",
      "value_range": [-4.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear education signal strongly correlated with income.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(education_num - 10.139) / 2.555"
    },
    {
      "name": "hours_per_week_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weekly working hours standardized.",
      "value_range": [-4.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth continuous work-intensity signal for linear models.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(hours_per_week - 40.869) / 11.847"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_capital_gain",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed capital gain to compress heavy tail.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "transformation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linearizes the strongly skewed capital_gain variable for SVM margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(capital_gain)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_capital_loss",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed capital loss.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 9.0],
      "feature_family": "transformation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses tail of capital_loss into a usable linear feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(capital_loss)"
    },
    {
      "name": "capital_net_log_signed",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Signed log of net capital position (gain minus loss).",
      "value_range": [-9.0, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "transformation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Single smooth capital signal capturing direction and magnitude.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(capital_gain >= capital_loss, np.log1p(capital_gain - capital_loss), -np.log1p(capital_loss - capital_gain))"
    },
    {
      "name": "hours_education_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction of standardized hours and education for compounding effect.",
      "value_range": [-20.0, 20.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures joint effect of high education and long hours in a linear-friendly product.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((education_num - 10.139) / 2.555) * ((hours_per_week - 40.869) / 11.847)"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_education_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction of standardized age and education.",
      "value_range": [-12.0, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures experience-times-credential joint signal for the linear hyperplane.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((age - 38.587) / 13.24) * ((education_num - 10.139) / 2.555)"
    },
    {
      "name": "prime_working_age_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Smooth bump centered at age 45 indicating peak earning years.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "severity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a non-linearized continuous severity score the linear model can use directly.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(1.0 - np.abs(age - 45.0) / 25.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "overtime_intensity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Hours worked beyond 40 per week, clipped.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 60.0],
      "feature_family": "severity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights overtime workers via a one-sided continuous severity measure.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(hours_per_week - 40.0, 0.0, 60.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "socioeconomic_stability_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic composite score (0-1) approximating household/employment stability based on marital_status, relationship, and workclass code patterns. Higher values indicate married-civilian, established-relationship, private/self-employed stable profiles.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes domain knowledge that stable household and employment configurations correlate with higher earnings into a smooth linear-friendly score.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "human_capital_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic 0-1 score combining education credential level, occupation skill tier, and age-experience plateau into an interpretable human-capital index.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Gives the linear SVM a single dense interpretable axis encoding skill/credential richness.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
